verdict.rationale: Orb's docs cover billable metrics with flexible aggregation/SQL (orb-docs-5, orb-docs-18), subscription edits and plan changes with proration (orb-docs-10, orb-docs-16), minimums/maximums for commitments and overage (orb-docs-20), and subscription/plan configuration via UI or API — collectively supporting tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription+usage pricing without custom code. missing for 10: explicit named documentation pages for each pricing model (tiered/volume/graduated) and credits/prepaid commitment mechanics, plus independent (non-vendor) confirmation of these pricing structures in production use.
